content.description: Illustration showing removal of oil cooler pipe clamp and disconnection of oil cooler pipes from transmission case

items: (a) Remove the oil cooler pipe clamp from the transmission case.
(b) Disconnect the two oil cooler pipes from the transmission case.

content.description: Illustration showing disconnection of manual shift linkage at rear connection and speedometer cable

content.text: Disconnect the shift linkage at the rear connection.

content.text: 13. REMOVE EXHAUST PIPE BRACKET AND CONVERTER COVER BOTH STIFFENER PLATES FROM TRANSMISSION HOUSING AND CYLINDER BLOCK

content.description: Illustration showing removal of power steering gear housing from crossmember, including sliding yoke, tie rod ends, fluid line clamps, bolts, and brackets

items: (a) Remove the sliding yoke from gear housing.
(b) Disconnect both tie rod ends with SST. SST 09611-22012
(d) Remove the four bolts and remove the two brackets and rubber insulator.
(e) Remove the gear housing from the crossmember and suspend it with strings.

content.description: Special Service Tool for disconnecting tie rod ends
Illustration showing jacking up transmission with wooden block placed between jack and transmission pan, with transmission raised to remove weight from rear support member

content.text: If a transmission jack is not available, be sure to put a wooden block between the jack and the transmission pan to prevent damage.
Raise the transmission enough to remove the weight from the rear support member.
